Name: Michael, Son of Jeshishai
Summary: Son of Jeshishai son of Jahdo son of Buz in Gad's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 5:14: Son of Jeshishai son of Jahdo son of Buz in Gad's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Michael stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
